item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00342","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C01","C07","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C01","confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C01 plausibly supplied the child’s concrete letter template: the same salutation, an opening transmitting a draft bill, a concise argument for prompt enactment, notice of an enclosed cabinet secretary’s letter, and the same closing. The closely matching wording and sequence go beyond the generic fact that both concern proposed legislation. C07 and C03 contain unusually close highway-specific concepts—pay-as-you-go financing and keeping the interstate program on schedule—but neither matches the child’s drafting structure as fully as C01.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"My dear Mr.___________: I am transmitting herewith the draft of a bill which will make it possible to complete our interstate highway system by 1972.","parent_excerpt":"My dear Mr.__________: I am transmitting herewith a draft of a bill to extend the coverage of the Fair Labor Standards Act and to increase the minimum wage.","explanation":"The opening sentence uses essentially the same personalized salutation and bill-transmittal construction, adapted to a different legislative target."},{"child_excerpt":"Unless this legislation is enacted promptly, apportionments to the States will have to be reduced substantially below desired levels.","parent_excerpt":"This bill provides needed improvements in the Fair Labor Standards Act, and I urge its prompt consideration.","explanation":"Both letters move from transmitting the bill to a compact justification for prompt congressional action."},{"child_excerpt":"I am also enclosing a letter from the Secretary of Commerce dealing with the measure.","parent_excerpt":"I am also enclosing the letter I received from the Secretary of Labor commenting briefly upon the provisions in the draft bill.","explanation":"The closing administrative sentence is closely parallel in language and function, substituting the responsible cabinet secretary."}]}
